features.name: Hand cannon with scripted cannonball arc
features.summary: A carried 'hand cannon' (a cheat item) fires a scripted cannonball: the script traces a falling arc straight ahead of the shooter, killing anyone the ball passes within 1.5 m of and knocking down or stunning anyone within 3 m, until the arc reaches the ground where it throws up smoke and dirt.
features.mechanics: itm_cannon_visible ti_on_weapon_attack (93 stmts; the same block is also attached to itm_cannonball_box_3lb): sound + muzzle fire/smoke; finds the nearest human (the shooter); then loops reg5 = 1..499, each step moving a probe 1.6 m further forward and dropping it by reg5^2/2 cm (a parabola). For every live agent: < 1.5 m from the probe -> agent_set_hit_points 0 + agent_deliver_damage_to_agent (kill) + blood burst; < 3 m -> humans lose HP scaled by item slot 79 of their shield and item slot 77 of their body armour, play rider_fall_roll + snd_man_stun, horses scaled by slot 77 and horse_rear; anyone left under 15 HP is killed. When the probe is at or below ground level the loop stops, bursts psys_war_smoke_tall/psys_map_village_fire_smoke and moves instance 0 of spr_city_swad_02 there (an impact marker animated upward).
evidence: slot oa1860 item 77 / item 79: read-only, never written
refs oa1860 item itm_cannon_visible -> 0 bytecode references (inventory-only item)

features.name: Exploding grenades, dynamite and shells
features.summary: Thrown grenades and dynamite (and several ammo items) explode where they land, hurting everyone within 2.5 m for 60-100 damage with fire and smoke.
features.mechanics: ti_on_missile_hit trigger (19 stmts, identical block on itm_grenade, itm_dynamite_big, itm_us_grenade (18), itm_blackpowder_barrel, itm_cannonball, itm_cannonball_12lb, itm_arrows, itm_bodkin_arrows): runs on server or single-player; for every agent within 250 cm of the impact, store_agent_hit_points (absolute), subtract 60-99, agent_set_hit_points, and if that reaches 0 agent_deliver_damage_to_agent from the thrower to credit the kill; psys_pistol_smoke + psys_village_fire_big bursts and snd_gun_shoot at the impact.
evidence: diff of itm_arrows/t0 and itm_cannonball/t0 against itm_grenade/t0 -> identical

features.name: Explosive powder barrels and destructible field cover
features.summary: Scene props such as sandbags, sandbag walls, cavalry spikes, doors and earthwork sally gates can be shot or hacked to pieces; black-powder barrels explode when destroyed, damaging everyone within 3 m in proportion to how close they stood.
features.mechanics: Generic destructible set on spr_sandbag, spr_sandbag_wall, spr_cav_spikes, spr_door_destructible, spr_earth_sally_gate_left/right: ti_on_scene_prop_init scene_prop_set_hit_points 10; ti_on_scene_prop_hit dummy sound + psys_dummy_smoke/straw; ti_on_scene_prop_destroy sinks the prop 12 m (prop_instance_animate_to_position). spr_blackpowder_barrel destroy (21 stmts): explosion smoke, sink, then for agents within 300 cm: damage = 300 - distance(cm), applied via agent_set_hit_points + agent_deliver_damage_to_agent (self-credited).
evidence: sqlite: spr_door_destructible triggers 2/5/3 stmts in oa1860 vs 8/2/40 in native/cae

features.name: Buy a ship in port towns
features.summary: In nine coastal towns the player can pay 5000 to put to sea; the party is moved onto nearby water and travels as a ship.
features.mechanics: menu:town/opt:sail_from_port: Native's cheat-only option, re-gated to 9 specific towns (this_or_next chain) and routed through menu_confirm_ship: if gold >= 5000, remove gold, $g_player_icon_state = 2, party_set_flags pf_is_ship (512), map_get_water_position_around_position, party_set_position, change_screen_return.

features.name: Per-gun muzzle smoke and fire effects
features.summary: Each firearm emits smoke and a muzzle flash from its own barrel position when fired.
features.mechanics: ti_on_weapon_attack item triggers of 4-7 statements on dozens of guns (113 item-trigger blocks in total) (e.g. itm_henry: sound, offset to the lock, psys_cooking_smoke, offset to the muzzle, psys_pistol_smoke + psys_cooking_fire_1).

features.name: Showdowns, Shootouts and colonial army menus (renamed Native)
features.summary: The 'Showdowns' tournament, 'Shootouts' arena duels and 'colonies army' quest menus look new but are Native's tournament, arena-duel and kingdom-army menus with words replaced.
features.mechanics: Shape-identical to Native: menu_town_Showdowns = menu_town_tournament (incl. 122-stmt join_next_fight), Showdowns_bet/_confirm/_participants = tournament_*, Shootouts_duel_fight/_conclusion = arena_duel_*, colonies_army_* = kingdom_army_*; menu:camp_action/opt:action_rename_colonies = Native rename kingdom.
evidence: sqlite: oa1860 menu shape_hash == native menu shape_hash for every Showdowns/Shootouts/colonies block (n_stmts > 3)

features.name: Camp-menu cheat-mode toggle (broken)
features.summary: Camp > Take an action offers 'Enable cheat mode' / 'Disable cheat mode', but the options flip the wrong variable, so cheat mode is not actually toggled.
features.mechanics: menu:camp_action/opt:action_enable_cheat_mode: cond (eq $g_siege_final_menu 0), conseq (assign $g_siege_final_menu 1) and jump back; disable is the mirror. Native cheat options read $cheat_mode, which these never write.
evidence: sqlite: no other module has these option ids

features.name: Older-Native base shared with L'Aigle and CAE
features.summary: Almost all of 1860s' 155 'modified Native' scripts are not 1860s work: they are an older Native version that the CAE module and L'Aigle also run. 1860s itself only changed about ten scripts, nearly all multiplayer or custom-battle content.
features.mechanics: Shape-hash classification of the 155 modified scripts: 145 have the same shape as CAE's copy - 71 of those are Native-shaped and differ only in renamed resource names, 74 are genuinely older-Native code (60 of them also shared with L'Aigle) - and only 10 differ from both CAE and Native: game_receive_network_message, game_quick_start (custom battles, 'Gabrilduro's special Custom Battles'), game_start, initialize_item_info, determine_team_flags (multiplayer CTF/HQ flags for kingdoms 7-10), money_management_after_agent_death (multiplayer) plus 4 other multiplayer scripts. The one 'new' script, center_change_trade_good_production, is unreachable and also present in L'Aigle.
evidence: sqlite shape_hash classification oa1860 vs native/cae/laigle (counts above)
diff native vs oa1860 determine_team_flags (only multiplayer flag props added)
